 K-Pop group Demon Hunters embark on a world tour.
 VTV.vn - The Golden World Tour is scheduled to officially kick off on June 5, 2027, bringing the world of music from the K-Pop animated film phenomenon Demon Hunters closer to the audience.
 Đài truyền hình Việt Nam • 15/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Photo: Netflix
 The first leg of the tour spanned 35 cities with 61 shows. The North American leg lasted throughout the summer , with stops including the Prudential Center in Newark, the United Center in Chicago, State Farm Arena in Atlanta, and the American Airlines Center in Dallas.
 The Golden World Tour also came to Canada with two shows at the TD Coliseum in Hamilton on June 26th.
 The tour will begin in Europe on September 1st at the Hallenstadion in Zurich, then continue through Milan, Amsterdam, Vienna, Berlin, Hamburg, Copenhagen, Oslo, Cologne, Brussels, Paris, and Dublin. The UK leg will open on October 12th at the OVO Hydro in Glasgow and continue to Birmingham and Manchester before concluding with three shows at The O2 in London on October 22-23.
 You may also like “This is more than just a concert; it’s a unique show that will immerse fans in the story for the first time with live action and performers, beloved music and dance, and special performances,” the tour announcement stated. In addition to the Huntr/x characters, the shows will feature the animated characters Saja Boys and Devily Tiger.
 The schedule for the Asia Pacific and Latin America regions has not yet been announced. In 2027 and 2028, the Golden World Tour is expected to visit nearly 50 cities and hold more than 150 shows. 
 K-Pop's Demon Hunters has received numerous prestigious awards (Photo: Netflix)
 “ KPop Demon Hunters has transformed from a breakout phenomenon into a generational phenomenon – maintaining a position in Netflix’s global Top 10 for 63 consecutive weeks, surpassing 2 billion streams on Spotify for the song Golden , and breaking the all-time record for the longest-running number 1 soundtrack album on Billboard’s Top Soundtracks chart,” said Marian Lee, Netflix’s chief marketing officer. “This adoration isn’t just a one-off moment, and the Golden World Tour is our way of sustaining that, bringing the Takedown energy to the world .”
 You may also like Rich Schaefer, president of global tours at AEG Presents, said the franchise has become a global phenomenon, with its characters and music meaning a great deal to fans. He said, “We are excited to partner with Netflix to bring that world to life through the tour, with music at the heart of a show that lets fans be part of the adventure.”
 K-Pop Demon Hunters, released on Netflix on June 20, 2025, is the most-watched film on the platform to date, with over 670 million views. The film won Best Animated Film at the Academy Awards, the Golden Globes, and the Critics' Choice Awards. The song "Golden" made history as the first K-pop song to win both an Oscar and a Grammy, while the soundtrack was the first album to have four songs simultaneously reach the top 10 of the Billboard Hot 100 chart.
